title: The Amulet of Lost Voices
summary: Cast level 3 Speak with Dead once per Long Rest.

fields.Speak with Dead: Action at 30 ft. An eligible corpse normally answers up to five questions. After casting, Recast Speak with Dead can be used without another slot until Long Rest. A corpse usually refuses to speak to its killer.
fields.Acquisition: Heavy chest in Withers’ chamber in the Dank Crypt.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
